title: Five L3Harris Systems Achieve Jailbroken Status at US Army Events
summary: Multiple L3Harris Technologies systems received “Jailbroken” status at U.S. Army Operation Jailbreak events this year, including on a new autonomous threat-sensing capability.
body_markdown:
L3Harris unlocks a more connected battlefield in Operation Jailbreak.


L3Harris unlocks a more connected battlefield in Operation J...


**MELBOURNE, Fla., Oct. 8, 2026 —** Multiple L3Harris Technologies (NYSE: LHX) systems received “Jailbroken” status at U.S. Army Operation Jailbreak events this year, including on a new autonomous threat-sensing capability.


The Army’s experiments determined whether technologies had standards-based application programming interfaces for open-system integration into future networks. The L3Harris[Falcon® IV](https://www.l3harris.com/all-capabilities/falcon-iv-family-radios) family of radios,[Wraith®](https://www.l3harris.com/newsroom/editorial/2022/07/wraith-waveform-provides-truly-resilient-communications-tactical-edge) waveform and[Wraith Shield™](https://www.l3harris.com/newsroom/editorial/2026/05/wraith-shield-advantage-transforming-l3harris-radios-ai-enabled-counter) software,[WESCAM® MX®-Series](https://www.l3harris.com/all-capabilities/wescam-mx-series) electro-optical/infrared sensors, and[VAMPIRE®](https://www.l3harris.com/all-capabilities/vampire) counter-unmanned systems all received jailbroken status. The technology’s interoperability validation with any data layer is suitable for Army, joint and coalition warfighting architectures.


“Military operations are increasingly data-driven, and assured communications across the battlespace to share that data are essential for strategic and tactical decision advantage,” said Chris Aebli, President, Communications & Spectrum Dominance, L3Harris. “We are focused on supporting the Army’s Right to Integrate initiative with open, adaptable and scalable systems to accelerate interoperability across multiple battlefield systems.”


The three-week exercises also included L3Harris working with three industry partners to connect communication systems with WESCAM MX-Series sensors and VAMPIRE through the Wraith waveform. This action demonstrated an interoperable, deployable robotic system that enables early intelligence and warning for improved decision advantage for combatant commanders.
